The ice cream shows signs of slight melting and has a smooth, creamy texture with visible scoop ridges. A metal spoon is partially visible on the right side, and the dessert is served on a white plate.

custom_prompts_for_reflector: Pay close attention to the interface between the ice cream and the cake. AI models often struggle with material interactions, causing solids to merge. Also, scrutinize the 'smoothness' of the ice cream; real ice cream usually has micro-texture even when smooth. If the classifier confirms 'ice cream' but the texture auditor flags 'plastic-like' qualities, prioritize the visual artifact evidence in the final score.
